pending.title: #TSLA AT THE REVERSAL TRIGGER — $389.75 NEXT IF IT HOLDS TODAY #Tesla #daytrading
pending.description:
Please ❤️like and 🔁share with fellow Tesla traders/investors

#Tesla closed yesterday at $366.20 alongside the broad post-Fed market reversal, and is trading above $368 today. 

That puts #TSLA right at the reversal area we were watching yesterday — but the key question is whether it can hold these levels at the closed today.

The immediate pivot is $367.54, the bottom of the six-week channel, with another short-term level at $366.97.

If TSLA opens and holds above this $366.97–$367.54 zone, there is a potential day-trade move toward $378.63.

More importantly, a clear close above $367.54 would challenge the six-week sell signal triggered earlier this week and could put $389.75 back in play over the next 3–5 trading days.

*

But $389.75 is where the bigger test begins.

Two months ago, TSLA closed below its 18-month rising channel bottom around $389.75, triggering the longer-term sell signal that still points toward $228.83 over a 3–6 month horizon.

The stock subsequently found support around the descending-channel bottom near $285 and rallied back toward $389.75, but it has yet to invalidate that larger bearish structure.

*

The major resistance zone remains $389.75–$408.56. 

As long as TSLA remains below $389.75, the longer-term bearish setup remains intact. A rally into $389.75–$408.56 could still be a countertrend move rather than a new long-term breakout.

*

A weekly close above $408.56 would change that picture significantly.

That would invalidate the bearish setup in this framework and instead open the possibility of a move toward the $540s–$550s over the following six months.

*

On the downside, if today's pre-market strength fails and TSLA opens back below $366.97, $353.39 becomes the immediate downside level to watch.

If the stock falls into the $350s and stays there, $330.48 could come into reach within a couple of weeks, followed potentially by another test of $285 over the next couple of months.

*

So today's plan is straightforward:
– Hold $367.54 → $378.63 → $389.75
– Lose $366.97 → $353.39 → $330.48 → potentially $285

Yesterday, $368.18 was the potential reversal trigger. Today we're testing that area.

Now the question is whether TSLA can actually hold it through the session and confirm the move up higher next week.

*

If you enjoyed this update, please 👍🏻 like and 🔁 share
